What the shop does

Cuts and fades

Scissor cuts, buzz cuts, fades and custom cuts. Customers write that the barbers are meticulous and never rush the job.

Beards and shaves

Beard trim and beard maintenance, and a shave. One customer was in and out with a haircut and a shave in 20 minutes on his way to work.

Kids’ cuts

Parents have been bringing their boys for years. Google lists the shop as good for kids.

Walk-ins only

No booking needed. Even when people are waiting, customers write that the line moves quickly.

Why regulars keep coming

What customers notice on Google.

They know their regulars

Customers write that they are not just another random customer, and some have been coming for six or eight years.

Clean and cool

Cleanliness comes up in 11 reviews. Inside it is air-conditioned, with water offered and comfortable sofas while you wait.

Parking at the back

The shop has its own private parking at the back.

A family business since 2002

Andys Barbershop has been cutting hair in Limassol since 2002, as the logo says. Today a team of six barbers works under the black and white awning, purely on a walk-in basis. On busy Saturdays there can be a wait, and many regulars simply see it as part of the experience.
